Exterior Chimney Makeover: Upgrade a Plain Chimney Without a Full Remodel
See how this homeowner upgraded a plain exterior chimney into a clean, modern feature using stone—without tearing anything down.

Brian Cassel

Senior Project Coordinator

Hi, I’m Brian, and I worked with this homeowner on a project to upgrade their exterior chimney.

The chimney was structurally sound, but it stood out for the wrong reasons. The plain siding made it feel unfinished and out of place compared to the rest of the home.

They wanted a way to turn it into a feature instead of an eyesore—without a complicated renovation.

See What Your Home Could Look Like

From Flat Siding to a High-Impact Stone Feature
Make Your Chimney Modern • Installs Over Existing Chimney Exterior

Instead of rebuilding the chimney, we installed stone veneer directly over the existing surface. This gave the chimney a completely new look, adding depth, texture, and architectural presence.

✅ Installed over existing exterior

✅ No structural changes required

✅ Adds height and visual interest

✅ Completed in days, not weeks

A Complete Chimney Transformation Without a Full Remodel
What once felt like an afterthought now acts as a focal point of the home’s exterior.

Before

The Goal

- Plain siding chimney lacked detail

- Drew attention in a negative way

- Didn’t match the home’s style

- Looked unfinished and outdated

After

The Solution

- Add stone veneer to the chimney exterior

- Create a vertical focal point

- Introduce texture and contrast

- Upgrade curb appeal instantly

What Does a Chimney Makeover Like This Cost?

Projects like this typically range between $3,000–$10,000, depending on height and access. Much more affordable than rebuilding—and far less invasive.

Try Visualizer Get Your Project Estimate

Project Details

- Products Used: Panels, Corners

- Color: Northern Slate

- Install: Over Existing Siding

Can You Install Stone Over a Chimney?

Yes, GenStone can be installed over any flat surface as long as the substrate is structural. To install over concrete, brick or stucco we recommend using Tapcon screws and construction adhesive. For all other substrates, deck screws are the recommended fastener.

Is It Safe for Exterior Chimneys?

Yes, GenStone is engineered for exterior use and will endure the elements like any other siding product.

Does This Work on Wood or Siding?

GenStone can be installed over any flat, sturdy surface.

How Long Does Installation Take?

GenStone is as simple as measure, cut and attach. A chimney like the one featured in this article would take two people about a day and a half and one person no longer than two or three days to complete.

Northern Slate Color Guide

Northern Slate was chosen to give the chimney a clean, modern stone appearance that contrasts the siding and adds depth to the exterior.
